import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
b = pd.read_csv("outputs/backtest_predictions.csv", parse_dates=["utc_timestamp"])
print("backtest ts max", b.utc_timestamp.max(), "(must be < 2020)")
m = json.load(open("outputs/metadata.json")); w80, w95 = m["empirical_interval_half_width_80_mw"], m["empirical_interval_half_width_95_mw"]
bl = b[b.model=="blend"].assign(err=lambda x: x.actual_mw-x.prediction_mw)
for (stage, origin), g in bl.groupby(["stage","origin"]):
    e = g.err.to_numpy(); a=np.abs(e)
    print(f"{stage:11s} {origin} n={len(e)} MAE={a.mean():7.0f} bias={e.mean():7.0f} maxabs={a.max():6.0f} cov80={(a<=w80).mean():.2f} cov95={(a<=w95).mean():.2f}")
ny = bl[bl.origin.str.endswith("01-01")]
a = np.abs(ny.err)
print("pooled New Year weeks: cov80", round((a<=w80).mean(),2), "cov95", round((a<=w95).mean(),2), "q80", round(np.quantile(a,.8)), "q95", round(np.quantile(a,.95)))
cal = bl[bl.stage=="calibration"]; a=np.abs(cal.err)
print("calibration pooled: cov80", round((a<=w80).mean(),2), "cov95", round((a<=w95).mean(),2), "lag1 autocorr", round(pd.Series(cal.err.to_numpy()).autocorr(1),2))
# per-day error on New Year weeks
ny = ny.assign(day=(ny.utc_timestamp - pd.to_datetime(ny.origin, utc=True)).dt.days)
print(ny.groupby(["origin","day"]).err.mean().unstack().round(0))
ms = pd.read_csv("outputs/model_selection.csv"); print(ms)
bm = pd.read_csv("outputs/backtest_metrics.csv"); print(bm.groupby(["model","group"]).mae_mw.mean().unstack().round(1))
print(bm[bm.group=="calibration"][["origin","mae_mw","rmse_mw","mape_percent"]])
'
